'''B3-S1''', commonly referred to as "'''Bessi'''," was a unique [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droid]] owned by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Lane Vizla]] at the time of the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="Burc'ya Vaal Burk'yc">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Burc'ya Vaal Burk'yc|[[Carrick Station]]}}</ref>

==Biography==
Bessi was rescued from a secret [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] on [[Ruhnuk]], where [[Kur Ha'rangir]], had subjected her to cruel experiments in his quest to enhance Bessi's formidable machines. At some point when Bessi was rescued, Lane Vizla undertook the task of studying and repairing Bessi, scouring [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for information and resources.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|B3-S1}}</ref>

Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.5}}</ref> Vizla asked the [[Alliance Commander]] to see her latest project and was tasked with taking Bessi out and training her with training modules.<ref name="Burc'ya Vaal Burk'yc" /> Later, Vizla mentioned that Bessi required repairs to her memory circuits. [[Shebs]], an [[HK-24 series assassin droid|HK-24]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] then suggested that the Commander travel to [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] to locate an HK-24 series [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] in order to obtain the memory circuits, the Commander later returned with the memory circuits and handed it over to Vizla. After Bessi was repaired, Vizla thanked both the astromech and the Commander, expressing gratitude for both of their help.<ref name="Missing Parts">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Missing Parts|[[Ruhnuk]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
B3-S1 appears as part of Lane Vizla's storyline in Game Update 7.5 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''. Players can earn and upgrade Bessi as a companion through the new ventures system.<ref name="TORweb">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20240502-0|text=Game Update 7.5 "Desperate Defiance" Recap and VOD}}</ref>
